It requires identity handle mapping. It does not alter output admission.

PASS: selected physical SCALE graph, ASCII/Binary output/readback, late source-mutation rejection, destination preservation and same-writer retry.

limits: The new controls inspect in-memory synthetic section bodies; they do not call fileExport, test destination rollback, or establish native consumer acceptance for the three-root source.
The APPID row census covers recognized symbol rows only, not all table record types, and does not replace global writer-ledger uniqueness, source-to-output alias binding, or finalization evidence.
The check accepts identity mapping only. Differently mapped staged output, complete NOD target closure, selected graph output, full strict export and producer semantics remain unproved.
The original aerial witness still has an unrelated SUN owner obstruction before full output can be staged.
No external drawing fixture was added or committed.
independentReview: Static review verified the absent-handle mapper, source-bound companion EED and table match, dictionary/XRECORD/SCALE transport checks, and mutation/retry controls within the synthetic-view scope.
